about: [O6b critic] the el's hung lamp: from the start of the bed, aim at the nearest hung lamp's head and fire a short burst; does it go out, is it seen to?

steps.eval: (() => { const S=G.stage.smash, c=N.controller.pos; let b=null, bd=1e9; for (const it of S.items) { if (it.kind!=='hanglamp') continue; const d=Math.hypot(it.x-c.x, it.z-c.z); if (d<bd && d>4) { bd=d; b=it; } } window.__hl=b; return JSON.stringify({n:S.items.filter(i=>i.kind==='hanglamp').length, d:bd, at:[b.x,b.z]}); })()

steps.look: (() => { const C=N.controller; const it=window.__hl; const h=it.lamp.head; const e=G.camera.position; const dx=h.x-e.x, dz=h.z-e.z, dy=h.y-e.y; let dyaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz)-C.yaw; dyaw=Math.atan2(Math.sin(dyaw),Math.cos(dyaw)); const dp=Math.atan2(dy,Math.hypot(dx,dz))-C.pitch; if (window.__pe!=null && Math.abs(dp)>Math.abs(window.__pe)*1.1 && Math.abs(dp)>0.05) window.__ps=-(window.__ps||1); window.__pe=dp; const s=window.__ps||1; return [-dyaw/C.sensitivity*0.9, s*dp/C.sensitivity*0.9]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const it=window.__hl; const h=it.lamp.head; const e=G.camera.position; const dx=h.x-e.x, dz=h.z-e.z, dy=h.y-e.y; let dyaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz)-N.controller.yaw; dyaw=Math.atan2(Math.sin(dyaw),Math.cos(dyaw)); return JSON.stringify({d:+Math.hypot(dx,dz).toFixed(1), h:+h.y.toFixed(1), dyaw:+dyaw.toFixed(3), dp:+(Math.atan2(dy,Math.hypot(dx,dz))-N.controller.pitch).toFixed(3), st:it.state, dark:!!it.dark, hits:it.hits, ammo:G.guns&&G.guns.ammo}); })()
